system.description:
• Effect: Your pace sets the roll. Half speed or less: Advantage. Normal speed: a normal roll. Running or charging: Disadvantage (where anyone else can't try at all).
  • Together: you may Hide and Move Silently at once, at your pace, with no extra penalty.
  • Lightly obscured: you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
  • Listen: you ignore the Disadvantage for listening through a solid barrier (see Disengage & Hide in The Arneyan Codex), and you follow whispered speech through a door as if you were in the room.

activities.name: Hide
activities.text: Conceal yourself; you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on 12 to 14. Your pace sets the roll: half speed or less, Advantage; normal speed, a normal roll; running or charging, Disadvantage. You may Hide and Move Silently at once, at your pace, with no extra penalty.

activities.name: Move Silently
activities.text: Move without sound. Your pace sets the roll: half speed or less, Advantage; normal speed, a normal roll; running or charging, Disadvantage.

activities.name: Listen
activities.text: Listen for sounds. You ignore the Disadvantage for listening through a solid barrier, and follow whispered speech through a door as if you were in the room.
